surface.briefText: Run gui-improve again, this time on the Board tab of the panel General settings (settings-panel-board, data-settings-tab="board"), using the new per-stage worktree architecture that is now on main: every stage cut from the one frozen parent, each stage tree recorded under its stage id so all of them stay attached in the chart. Walk baseline, implement, compare, review and correct through the panel driver, not as one local worker. Acceptance is the baseline capture at the recorded viewports and states, an implementation committed on its stage tree, a comparison page pairing every after shot with its before, the review gate free to reject with a note, and the change landed by PR so the improvement is code on main rather than only a ledger entry.
surface.change: The 'Folders the board scans' block must read as one control group: a visible gap between each root's path, its state chip and its remove control, and the add-folder field given the width its row has left so its hint is readable.
surface.changeSource: Measured in this baseline: the root rows have no gap at all between the path and the 'exists' chip (0 px), 3.9 px between the chip and the remove ✕, and the add-folder input is 154 px of a 310 px row while its own placeholder needs 382.7 px, so it paints as 'an absolute folder pat…' and 74 px of the row stays empty. public/style.css has no rule for .settings-root/.settings-root-path/.settings-root-chip/.settings-root-x/.settings-roots-add at all — lib-side markup from public/app.js:15814-15821, unstyled.
surface.reproduce: The captured pixels are the served build's public/index.html, app.js and style.css (hashes in environment). To shoot the after state of an edit in this worktree, serve THIS worktree on a free port with its own PANEL_CONFIG (public/ is read per request; lib/ needs a restart) and follow the same steps at the same viewport and the same body scrollTop. The 340x520 surfaceFile depends only on the public files and the settings config the panel serves (the scan roots it lists), not on the live board behind the window.
surface.scope: The whole Settings window (#settings): its head, search box, tab strip and the visible Board panel. Hidden tabs are not painted and are excluded.
surface.landing: The change must land as code on main, not only as a change-set: apply it in this stage's tree, commit on that tree's branch, push the branch and open the PR against main with the comparison page linked from the PR body. A later correct visit that changes the accepted change-set must push to the same branch, so the PR head is the change the review accepted.

environment.servedNote: public/index.html is rewritten by the panel for cache-busting (stylesheet links carry ?v=<panel-build> and a meta panel-build tag is added), so its hash differs from the tree by that stamp and nothing else; app.js and style.css are byte-identical.

states.name: open
steps: Fresh browser context at the viewport (no localStorage, so the settings window and tab are at their defaults).
wait for #btn-settings and for the first /api/state paint (2.5 s settle).
click #btn-settings to open the Settings window.
click #settings-tab-board (aria-selected=true on the Board tab; #settings-panel-board not hidden).
set #settings .settings-body scrollTop to 0 and wait two animation frames for layout to settle.
assert #settings is visible, #settings-panel-board is the only visible [data-settings-group], and #settings-search is empty.

states.name: presets
steps: Reach the open state exactly as above.
scroll #settings .settings-body so the first .settings-presets (the Board reorder pills) sits in the middle of the body: element.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}).
wait two animation frames and 250 ms; record the body's scrollTop in the inventory.
assert the Board tab is still selected and the panel is still the only visible group.

states.name: search
steps: Reach the open state exactly as above.
fill #settings-search with "flash" (the Board rows that answer it: Flash time, Flash on events, Grey flash).
wait 900 ms for the filter to paint, then assert the Board tab is still selected and the search badge reads the number of visible rows.
set #settings .settings-body scrollTop to 0 and wait two animation frames.
